inputs.coverage: Lucy stereo images constrain about 40% of the surface. The source authors completed the unseen part using a two-ellipsoid fit and symmetry; it is not all observed terrain. The body tumbles, and the preliminary frame is accurate only near the 2025 encounter. This display uses a fixed illustrative orientation and does not propagate that attitude. No registered optical surface map is supplied.
